input: Research grants for small creative businesses

gold.taskTitle: Research Grants for Your Small Creative Business
gold.taskDescription: Find and evaluate grant opportunities suited to the user's small creative business.

questions.title: What type of creative business do you run?
questions.description: Identify the specific creative field, such as visual art, music, writing, design, craft, film, or another discipline.

questions.title: What country and region is your business based in?
questions.description: Determine the geographic location to narrow grants to those the user is actually eligible for.

questions.title: Is your business officially registered or still informal?
questions.description: Establish the legal status of the business, as many grants require formal registration such as an LLC, sole proprietorship, or nonprofit.

questions.title: How long has your business been operating?
questions.description: Find out the business age, since some grants target startups while others require a minimum track record.

questions.title: What is the approximate annual revenue of your business?
questions.description: Clarify the revenue range to match grants that have specific small-business size or income thresholds.

questions.title: What would the grant funding specifically be used for?
questions.description: Understand the intended use of funds, such as equipment, marketing, hiring, a specific project, or general operating costs.

questions.title: Do you have a deadline by which you need to apply?
questions.description: Determine if there is a time constraint driving this research, such as a known grant cycle or an urgent business need.
